crossRefs.note: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.

translations.web: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.
translations.bsb: When the steward overtook them, he relayed these words to them.
translations.kjv: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
translations.asv: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these words.
